correctness.rationale: The first-occurrence greedy subsequence embedding establishes an exact recurrence for every shortest absent word. Four explicit 32-bit base cases and four symbolic transfer calculations with a formal residual language R propagate the boundary suffixes m,m,m-1 and 0R,0R,R, proving S(AU)=B S(U) independent of earlier blocks; then induction handles arbitrary q and fixed 12-bit boundaries prove distinctness/cardinality. The paperfolding odd-part residue formula partitions every aligned 32-block into these templates, and its final bit at 2^k is 1. Independent full greedy shortest-language checks covered all 4+16+64 blocks concatenations; a separately coded symbolic reverse transfer checked the 4 all-block identities, not just finite k. Initial k=3,4 exceptions remain outside asserted uniform range.

value.rationale: An exact entire language of shortest missing scattered subsequences, not only universality order, with independence of all internal block choices except the last bit. This is a natural nontrivial structural block theorem for regular paperfolding prefixes, whose full language cardinality is doubly exponential in dyadic rank.

final_claim: For all q>=1 and 32-bit blocks A_(a,b)=110110011100100 a 110110001100100 b, the shortest absent scattered-subsequence language is B^q for last b=0 or B^q Sigma for last b=1, B={00x011001y11:x,y binary}. Hence iota=12q-1+b_last and |SAS|=4^q 2^b_last. For regular paperfolding dyadic prefix length 2^k, k>=5, q=2^(k-5), last bit 1, SAS=B^q Sigma.
